# Basis Universal

AXM vendors the official Basis Universal 2.10 final snapshot encoder module for local KTX2 texture delivery.

- Upstream: https://github.com/BinomialLLC/basis_universal
- Tag: `v2_10_final_snapshot`
- Commit: `1aab02ba2df16ad873229030ea191ea8c10e3fc9`
- License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` in this directory)

The vendored JavaScript and WebAssembly hashes are pinned in `AXM-VENDOR-MANIFEST.json`. No network access is required at runtime.
